signals.usability_note: Clear daytime view of a two-story white colonial-style house frontage with lawn, though trees partially obscure the left side and a car is parked in the foreground.

professional_landscaping.evidence: Lawn is neatly mowed and foundation shrubs are tidy, but there is no crew, equipment, or other clear sign of professional service.

signals.notes: Well-kept colonial with a red front door and a neatly mowed lawn; a pickup truck is parked under the carport on the right and another pickup is parked at the neighboring property on the left, while the silver SUV in the foreground is parked on the street.
